# Indiahikes

> > India's premier trekking platform offering guided Himalayan expeditions and comprehensive DIY trek guides across the Western Ghats, Himalayas, and national parks.

Indiahikes specializes in organizing treks throughout India, from beginner-friendly weekend trails near Bangalore and Pune to challenging high-altitude Himalayan summits in Uttarakhand and Ladakh. The platform provides detailed trek guides, itineraries, and outdoor education resources for families and adventure seekers.

## Key Topics

- Himalayan trekking
- Western Ghats trails
- Uttarakhand expeditions
- Karnataka trekking destinations
- Beginner-friendly treks
- Weekend treks near major cities
- National park trekking
- High-altitude summit climbs
- DIY trek guides with GPX files
- Fort trekking in Maharashtra
- Family and children trekking
- Winter Himalayan treks
- Kerala and Wayanad trails
- Outdoor education programs
- Tea-house treks in Ladakh

## Featured Himalayan Expeditions

- [Pangarchulla Trek 2026 | India's Thrilling Summit Challenge](https://indiahikes.com/pangarchulla-peak-trek): Advanced Pangarchulla summit trek with Indiahikes in Indian Himalayas
- [Brahmatal Trek 2026 | Uttarakhand's Favourite Lake Trek](https://indiahikes.com/brahmatal-trek): Winter Brahmatal lake trek with Mt Trishul views in Uttarakhand Himalayas
- [Manali Kaisdhar Trek 2025 | Itinerary, Best Times to Visit](https://indiahikes.com/manali-kaisdhar-trek): Beginner-friendly Manali Kaisdhar Trek in Pir Panjal Himalayas with booking
- [Nanda Devi National Park Trek](https://indiahikes.com/documented-trek/nanda-devi-national-park-trek): UNESCO World Heritage Nanda Devi National Park Trek guide in Uttarakhand
- [Markha Valley Trek](https://indiahikes.com/documented-trek/markha-valley-trek): Ladakh's Markha Valley tea-house trek through Hemis National Park guide
- [Dhankar Lake Trek](https://indiahikes.com/documented-trek/dhankar-lake-trek): High-altitude Dhankar Lake trek guide in Spiti Valley near monastery

## Western Ghats & Karnataka Treks

- [Mullayanagiri Trek: Trek to the Highest Peak in Karnataka](https://indiahikes.com/documented-trek/mullayanagiri-peak-trek): DIY guide to Mullayanagiri, Karnataka's highest peak in Western Ghats
- [Kurinjal Trek- Trek to the hidden gem in Kudremukh](https://indiahikes.com/documented-trek/kurinjal-peak): Kurinjal Peak trek guide in Kudremukh National Park, Western Ghats
- [Bheemana Kindi Trek -  A Lesser Known Trail Hidden Beside The More Popular Kabbala Durga](https://indiahikes.com/documented-trek/bheemana-kindi-trek): DIY Bheemana Kindi rock arch trek near Bangalore with GPX file
- [Banasura Hill Trek](https://indiahikes.com/documented-trek/banasura-trek): Banasura Hill grasslands trek guide in Wayanad, Kerala with shola forests
- [Pakshipathalam Trek](https://indiahikes.com/documented-trek/pakshipathalam-caves): One-day Pakshipathalam cave trek in Wayanad, Kerala with bird-watching

## Maharashtra Fort Treks & Weekend Trails

- [Visapur Fort Trek](https://indiahikes.com/documented-trek/visapur-fort-trek): Self-guided Visapur Fort monsoon trek in Maharashtra with waterfalls
- [Sudhagad Trek](https://indiahikes.com/documented-trek/sudhagad-trek): Easy Sudhagad fort trek guide near Mumbai-Pune in Maharashtra
- [Durg Dhakoba Trek](https://indiahikes.com/documented-trek/durg-dhakoba-trek): Durg Dhakoba fort trek guide near Pune in Maharashtra's Western Ghats

## National Parks & Wildlife Trails

- [Satpura Forest Trail](https://indiahikes.com/documented-trek/satpura-forest-trail): Satpura Tiger Reserve jungle trail guide in Madhya Pradesh near Pachmarhi
- [Buxa Fort Trek](https://indiahikes.com/documented-trek/the-complete-guide-to-buxa-fort-trek): Complete guide to Buxa Fort Trek in West Bengal near Bhutan border

## Outdoor Education & Family Trekking

- [Children Trekking In The Himalayas: What Every Anxious Adult Needs To Know](https://indiahikes.com/blog/common-myths-about-children-trekking-debunked): Debunking children trekking myths with InSOUL's safe Himalayan expeditions
- [Nature Exposure Increases Children's Academic Success, Global Studies Confirm](https://indiahikes.com/blog/global-research-confirms-being-in-nature-improves-academic-performance): Science-backed research on how nature exposure improves children's learning
